title: Asset Library not Loading on Arch | Godot 4.4.1-3
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot 4.4.1-3 Arch Stable package
Not sure about the rest of the versions

### System information

Arch Linux. Godot 4.4.1-3 Stable (compatibility). AMD A8-4500M with Radeon HD Graphics

### Issue description

tried loading the Asset Library. it worked before. 
now it doesn't work.
